title: Which Parts Entries a ShieldCare Plan Meets on a Repair Claim
content:
Which of the parts entries booked against the job on a covered item are met by a Northbeam ShieldCare
Protection Plan is read from the job held by Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair: how many
parts entries stand on that job inside the window read, and what the diagnosis most recently recorded
on the job names.

| What the job shows | The parts met |
| --- | --- |
| 2 or more parts entries stand on the job in the window read, and the diagnosis most recently recorded on the job names a board-level failure | every parts entry booked on the job inside the window read is taken |
| 2 or more parts entries stand on the job in that window, and the diagnosis most recently recorded names something other than a board-level failure | the largest single parts entry booked on the job, whenever it was booked, is taken |
| every other job | the most recent parts entry booked on the job, whenever it was booked, is taken |

### Both sides of the entry count

Exactly 2 parts entries in the window read satisfies the count; a single entry does not, and the most
recent entry alone is then taken. Note the difference in reach between the rows: the first row is
confined to entries inside the window read, while the second and third rows look at the job whole and
may take an entry booked before that window opened.

### A case on hypothetical figures

A job carries parts entries of 60.00, 220.00 and 140.00, of which the 220.00 was booked before the window read
opened and the 140.00 is the most recent. With only the 140.00 inside the window, the parts met are the most
recent entry, 140.00. With 2 entries inside the window and a most recent diagnosis naming something other than
a board-level failure, the parts met are the largest single entry on the job, 220.00. With those same 2 entries
inside the window and a most recent diagnosis of a board-level failure, the parts met are the entries inside
the window, 60.00 and 140.00, coming to 200.00.
